IP_MODE.goal: Generate a single IP/DUT-with-VIP verification environment; no subsystem registry is involved
IP_MODE.note: Added CAP-M5M6-VLEVEL-001 (verification_level=IP -> environment_mode_router.resolve_environment_mode()'s _resolve_with_level() branch). Not present in Parent's own copy of this file either (a real, disclosed gap there too, not reproduced here) -- Parent's router reads verification_level.LEVEL_SEMANTICS directly for the IP_MODE case rather than this policy JSON, and this file is reference/documentation only, never loaded at runtime by the router (see resolve_environment_mode()'s own docstring: rules are transcribed into code, not read from this file).

SYSTEM_LEVEL_MODE.goal: Select completed subsystem environments and compose a System-Level/Full-SoC verification environment

missing_subsystem_behavior: invoke SUBSYSTEM_MODE builder for missing required subsystem, register it, then return to SYSTEM_LEVEL_MODE
